text: In nineteen twenty, one man promised to grow your money by fifty percent in forty five days.
asr: In 1920, one man promised to grow your money by 50% in 45 days.

text: Charles Ponzi said he was trading international postal coupons.
He paid early investors with money from new ones, and the crowds kept coming.
When reporters checked, there weren't enough coupons in the world to cover it.
The scheme collapsed in August, and it still carries his name.
